These terms explain how you may use the One Sky website and the AI Foundation course. By enrolling or using the website you agree to them. If you are enrolling a child, you agree to them on the child’s behalf as their parent or guardian.

One Sky is operated by [legal entity name, registered address and CIN/registration number].

1. The course

AI Foundation is an introductory course on Artificial Intelligence for children in Class 3–5, 6–10, 11 & 12. It is a short, self-paced course made up of animated story videos (the story “Ajji, This Is for You”, in eight short chapters) and guided discussion, practical activities, a quiz with explanations, a story project, and reflection and recap. Learners may complete it in one sitting or over several sessions. The course is designed to be done with a parent, guardian or teacher.

2. Accounts and access

You do not need to create an account. When you enrol, the learner’s enrolment and progress are saved in the web browser on the device used to enrol. To keep access, use the same device and browser and do not clear the website’s data. If access is lost, contact us with your order ID (see Payment Support).

Access period: [how long access lasts after enrolment, e.g. 12 months].

3. Who may enrol

The course is for children in Class 3–5, 6–10, 11 & 12. A parent or legal guardian must make the purchase and confirm at checkout that they are the child’s parent or guardian. Children should not make purchases themselves.

4. Payments

The price is ₹385 per learner for the full course, shown in Indian Rupees at checkout. [State whether prices include GST]. Payments are processed by [payment provider]; One Sky does not store card or bank details. Online payment is not yet live on this website. Cancellations and refunds are covered by our Refund Policy.

5. Acceptable use

  • Use the course for personal, family or classroom learning only.
  • Do not copy, resell, share publicly, or re-upload course videos, activities, quizzes or materials.
  • Do not try to bypass payment, break the website, or access other people’s information.
  • Do not post reviews or messages that are false, offensive, or include any child’s personal details.

6. Content ownership

All course content, including videos, stories, characters, activities, quizzes, illustrations, text and the One Sky name and logo, belongs to One Sky or its licensors. Enrolling gives you a personal, non-transferable right to use the course for the learner you enrolled. Drawings and work your child creates during activities remain yours.

7. School and group access

Schools, NGOs and sponsors can arrange access for groups of learners. Group terms, including the number of learners, pricing, invoicing and how teachers use the course in class, will be agreed in writing. [Confirm group/school terms]. Start at For Schools or Sponsor Learners.

8. Completion certificates

[Confirm whether One Sky issues completion certificates and on what basis, e.g. after all six course parts are completed]. Any certificate recognises completion of the One Sky AI Foundation course only. It is not a school grade or a government qualification.

9. Reviews

Parents and teachers may submit reviews. We check every review before publishing and may edit out personal details or decline to publish reviews that break these terms. We publish only the reviewer’s first name (if given) and role.

10. Availability and changes

We work to keep the website available, but it may sometimes be unavailable for maintenance or reasons outside our control. We may update the course content to improve it. We may update these terms; the version and effective date shown on this page apply.

11. Limitation of liability

[Liability wording to be drafted and approved by One Sky’s legal adviser].

12. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at [city] have jurisdiction.

13. Support

For help with the course, payments or these terms, visit Contact Us, Help & FAQs or Payment Support.

This policy explains what information the One Sky website collects, why, where it is kept, and the choices you have. One Sky is designed for children in Class 3–12, so we collect as little as possible and involve parents and guardians in every purchase. Data controller: [legal entity name and registered address].

1. What we collect, and why

InformationWhenWhyWhere it is kept today
Learner’s name (as entered by the parent)CheckoutTo show whose course it is on the order and in My LearningYour browser, on your device
Parent/guardian confirmationCheckoutTo confirm an adult made the purchase for the childYour browser, on your device

We do not ask for the child’s date of birth, photo, school, phone number, email or address. We do not use advertising, tracking cookies or analytics on this website. Please do not include any child’s personal details in reviews or messages.

2. No account, no sign-in

The website does not use accounts or passwords. Enrolments and progress are stored in your web browser’s local storage on your device. One Sky cannot see this information unless you share it with us (for example, an order ID in a support message).

3. Children’s privacy and parent/guardian involvement

  • A parent or guardian must complete every purchase and confirm they are the child’s parent or guardian.
  • We collect only the learner’s name to personalise the course, and nothing that identifies or contacts the child directly.
  • We do not track children or show them advertising.
  • Reviews are written by parents or teachers, checked before publishing, and must not include children’s personal details.
  • The chat box reminds users not to share personal details, and the assistant is instructed never to ask for them. Parents should supervise young children using the chat.
  • We intend to follow India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, including verifiable parental consent for children’s data. [Confirm the consent method with One Sky’s legal adviser before launch].

4. Who processes your information

  • Website hosting: [hosting provider and server region].
  • Payments (when online payment goes live): [payment provider]. They collect payment details directly; One Sky does not see or store card or bank details.
  • Email or database for messages and reviews (when connected): [provider].
  • AI chat answers: Anthropic (Claude) processes the text of chat questions to write answers. [Confirm Anthropic’s data retention terms for One Sky’s account].

We do not sell personal information.

5. How long we keep it

  • Information in your browser stays until you clear the website’s data in your browser.
  • Messages and reviews held by One Sky: [retention period].
  • Payment and invoice records: [retention period required by tax law].

6. Your choices and deletion requests

  • To delete information stored on your device, clear this website’s data in your browser settings. This also removes course access on that device.
  • To ask One Sky to access, correct or delete information we hold (such as a message or review), contact us through Contact Us. We will respond within [number of days].

7. Security

The website is served over HTTPS. We limit what we collect and who on our team can see it.

8. Grievance officer

[Name, email and address of the Grievance Officer]. Support contact details are listed on our Contact Us page.

9. Changes to this policy

We will update this page if what we collect changes, and show the new effective date at the top.

This policy explains what happens if you want to cancel, pay twice, or cannot access the course after paying. The AI Foundation course costs ₹385 per learner. Online payment is not yet live on this website, so no payments are currently being taken.

1. Cancellations and refund eligibility

[One Sky to confirm whether a purchase can be cancelled and refunded, and under what conditions, e.g. within a set number of days and before the course is started].

2. Duplicate payments

If you are charged more than once for the same learner and course, contact us with the order IDs or payment references. After we confirm the duplicate, we will refund the extra payment.

3. Paid but no access

If your payment went through but the course is not showing in My Learning, contact Payment Support with your order ID or payment reference. We will first try to restore access. If we cannot, the payment will be treated as a refund request under this policy.

4. How to request a refund

  1. Go to Payment Support and choose the issue that matches.
  2. Include the parent’s name, the order ID or payment reference, the payment date and the reason.
  3. We will reply to confirm whether the request is accepted.

5. How refunds are paid

Approved refunds are paid to the original payment method used for the purchase. We cannot pay refunds in cash or to a different account.

Processing time: [One Sky to confirm how many working days refunds take after approval]. Your bank or payment app may take extra time to show the credit.

6. School, group and sponsored purchases

Refunds for group, school or sponsored purchases follow the written agreement for that purchase. [Confirm].

7. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy. The version shown on this page, with its effective date, applies to purchases made after that date.
